title: Boundary-weighted barycenter spaces
summary: We study boundary-weighted barycenter spaces, in which an interior support point has cost (or weight) two and a boundary support point has cost one. These spaces are finite-dimensional topological models for the concentration patterns produced by noncompact boundary Euler--Lagrange functionals: an interior bubble carries twice the quantized mass of a boundary bubble, and very negative sublevels are therefore modeled by boundary-weighted rather than ordinary barycenters.
